description: Renders the Chandra research workflow (a directed hypergraph folded from the append-only ledgers) natively in the editor.
container.title: Chandra
view.graph.name: Workflow Graph
view.nodes.name: Nodes
view.nodes.welcome:
No knowledge-ledger nodes were found in this workspace. Ledgers are read from `//paper_

/*.jsonl` of every workspace folder. [Refresh](command:vibeChandra.refresh) [Configure the Ledger Root](command:workbench.action.openSettings?%22vibeChandra.ledgerRoot%22)
config.ledgerRoot:
Folder that holds the Chandra ledgers (`/paper_

/*.jsonl`), relative to each workspace folder.
config.papers: Papers to show in the workflow graph. Empty shows every paper found. **Chandra: Select Papers...** overrides this per workspace.
config.layoutDirection: Flow direction of the workflow graph until it is toggled in the view.
config.layoutDirection.auto: Left to right in the editor area, top to bottom in the narrow side bar view.
config.layoutDirection.lr: Dependencies flow from left to right.
config.layoutDirection.td: Dependencies flow from top to bottom.
